messages:
marie: Morning — I'm the new AE (marie). Trying to log into Salesforce and Aircall but I get 403 on both. Any who-to-ask for seat provisioning?

kelly-ops: @marie welcome! I can help. Did you get the onboarding checklist email? It has the account request links.

marie: I saw the checklist but clicking the Salesforce link just redirects to the SSO page then 403 after I sign in. Aircall says 'no license assigned'.

kelly-ops: Ok sounds like a provisioning gap. Can you paste your redwood email (no pii in public threads) and the exact error?

marie: email is marie@redwood.com. Error screenshot saved but short text: "403 Forbidden — access denied" for Salesforce. For Aircall it shows "No license assigned to user" on the webapp.

kelly-ops: Copying @it-helpdesk-bot to create the ticket. If anyone on infra has quick fix feel free.

it-helpdesk-bot: New ticket created: IT-2347 — "Seat provisioning: marie@redwood.com — Salesforce + Aircall". ETA for assignment: 2 business hours. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/IT-2347

tom_b: hey @marie — for immediate Aircall access you can use the mobile app but ping me if you need call routing/playbooks set up. I can share my canned configs.

marie: Thanks @tom_b — mobile works but would prefer desktop. Also can someone point me to the sales playbook one-pager and call script?

kelly-ops: Playbook one-pager is here: https://redwood.example.com/sales/playbooks/intro-one-pager (internal). Call script under /sales/collateral repo: search repo name 'sd-playbook' or ping me and I'll attach.

it-helpdesk-bot: IT-2347 updated: Assigned to kelly-ops-admin. Provisioning steps underway — will confirm once licenses are applied.

marie: Appreciate it. Also quick Q — do we have a standard voicemail greeting template?

tom_b: Yes — short one. Copy/paste: `Hi, this is [Your Name] with Redwood Inference. Sorry I missed you — please leave your name and best callback number and I’ll follow up within one business day.`

kelly-ops: @marie I've attached the onboarding zip to the ticket with Sales enablement collateral, example playbook snippets, and the onboarding checklist. If IT finishes before EOD I'll DM you the sign-in flow. :thumbsup:

it-helpdesk-bot: IT-2347 status: Completed. Licenses applied. Salesforce role: AE-Basic. Aircall: seat assigned, routing synced. Last action by kelly-ops-admin at 2026-03-23T15:19:12Z

marie: I can confirm I can log into Salesforce now and Aircall on desktop — thanks everyone!

kelly-ops: Excellent — added you to #sales-playbooks and to the sales drive. Tag me with any missing collateral. Welcome aboard! :tada:

onboarding-bot: Welcome message sent to marie (DM) with quickstart checklist and 1:1 scheduling link: https://cal.com/redwood/sales-30
